skills.name: Fraction Subtraction Basics
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions that already share a common denominator by subtracting their numerators.

skills.name: Common Denominator
skills.definition: Find equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtracting fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Mixed Number Regrouping
skills.definition: Borrow one whole unit from the whole-number part and convert it into the fractional part when the minuend's fraction is smaller than the subtrahend's fraction.

skills.name: Whole Minus Fraction
skills.definition: Subtract a fraction or mixed number from a whole number by converting the whole number into a fraction with the needed denominator.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Recognize and simplify an improper fraction (numerator ≥ denominator) appearing within a mixed number before or during subtraction.
